verdict.rationale: Highnote's core payment operations (issuing cards, spend rules, velocity controls, ledger, disputes, webhooks) are documented as GraphQL API-first, and the platform explicitly markets itself as API/SDK-driven for agentic use cases. However, several dashboard-specific features (inviting team members, configuring roles/permissions, viewing/replaying the event monitoring log) are described only in Dashboard docs with no mention of an equivalent API/mutation, suggesting not everything in the UI is exposed via API. Missing for 10: explicit API equivalents for team/organization management, roles-and-permissions configuration, and event-log replay, plus any independent confirmation of full UI/API parity.
